description: This file defines the ProductRelationshipDao interface, which specifies data access methods for handling product relationships in the catalog. It includes methods to retrieve product relationships based on type, products, group, and language.

classes.name: ProductRelationshipDao
classes.description: Interface for data access operations related to product relationships.

methods.name: getByType
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductRelationship objects filtered by store, type, product, and optionally language.

methods.name: listByProducts
methods.description: Returns relationships associated with a specific product.

methods.name: getGroups
methods.description: Returns product relationships that are grouped by store.

methods.name: getByGroup
methods.description: Retrieves relationships based on store and group name.
